comment: Leviathan 2.9.1 source (commit c37193d, branch puffy-rc3): Deepcache.cpp declares no parameters, inputs or outputs, so the entry is a first line, notes and menu items. Cache resolution is a plugin-wide setting held in Leviathan/Deepcache/settings.json rather than patch state, because changing it rebuilds the shared database. The module detects Stoermelder's MB and any other plugin that has taken the browser, and prints the conflict on its own menu instead of fighting for it.
